title: Plan a coding goal
selectTask: Enter a task ID above to prepare its coding goal, before a workspace is assigned.
boundary: Planning only. Saving creates a versioned task document; it does not run commands, wake an Agent, allocate budget, enable repairs, push, create an MR, or authorize release. Existing workspace, budget, review and publication controls still apply.
paths: Relative paths (one per line; . means the repository root)
testCommands: Test commands from the repository instructions
maxCostCents: Planned cost limit (cents; 0 means no billable allowance)
listHint: Enter one item per line. Commands are stored literally, never executed by this form. Allowed paths are a plan, not an execution sandbox.
saving: Saving once; waiting for the receipt…
saved: Goal document saved. No execution was started.
error: The current document could not be read or is not a valid goal template. Check permissions or review the task document; reload before editing.
unknown: Save was not confirmed. Do not repeat it. Reload the saved version to inspect the current revision before making another edit.
denied: Access is no longer available. The draft has been cleared.
invalid: Complete every field. Use a full SHA, credential-free URLs, relative paths without traversal or wildcards, an integer cost limit, and 0–2 repair rounds.
